copy_failed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it by hand.
palette_placeholder: Type a screen or a ticket ID
reopen_body: This tab has no console session. Open the console again from
err_network: The console server did not answer. Start it again with /testign:console.
err_not_found: Not found. It may have been moved or removed; go back to the list.
err_unreadable: This report file cannot be read. Open it in an editor to check it.
err_inconsistent: No revision file of this ticket is consistent with its folder.
err_config: config.json cannot be read. Fix the file, then reload the page.
err_template: The workbook does not fit this template. Pick another template.
err_start: The console could not start. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, open it again from /testign:console.
hash_reason_busy: The server is busy with other checks; reload in a moment.
hash_reason_repo_not_found: The repository named in the report is not on this machine.
hash_reason_report_incomplete: The report is missing refs or hashes.
hash_reason_git_error: git could not read the repository.
hash_stale_title: Hash check: code cited by the report changed
hash_stale_body: Survey again before writing test cases so a new revision pins the current hashes.
hash_moved_title: Hash check: develop moved on, outside the scope
hash_moved_body: No file cited by this report changed. You can keep working.
tickets_subtitle: Each ticket is a report folder in output_dir. Revisions are never overwritten.
tickets_empty_body: Survey a ticket with /testign:survey; its report folder then appears in output_dir.
tickets_stale_body: The report still opens, but survey again before writing test cases so the new revision pins the current hashes.
report_no_sections_body: This revision has no sections in the report layout. Open the file to check it.
report_no_finding: This question has no detail block in the report.
report_unreadable: The latest revision of this ticket cannot be read. Pick another revision or open the file to check it.
report_inconsistent: No revision of this ticket names this ticket and its own number. Check the files in the ticket folder.
trace_coverage_body: B*/R* rows with a test case · {n} cases in total
trace_gaps_body: These rows have an impact, but no test case traces to them.
trace_gaps_none: Every row that needs a case has one.
trace_orphans_body: These cases trace to no row of the report: an extra case, or a missing report row.
trace_orphans_none: Every case traces to a report row.
trace_waiting_body: These cases rest on an assumption that awaits an answer.
trace_waiting_none: No case is written on an assumption that awaits an answer.
trace_never_overwrite: Cells a tester edited are never overwritten
trace_no_cases: The workbook has no test case rows.
trace_mismatch_title: The workbook's headers differ from template {template}
trace_mismatch_body: The workbook may have been filled from another template. Pick the template it came from; the columns that differ are listed below.
trace_no_template_body: Trace reads a workbook with an explicit template. Register the template the workbook was filled from.
trace_no_workbook_body: When test cases are written, the filled workbook appears in this ticket's folder and its trace shows here.
tpl_subtitle: Customer Excel files. testign writes only into a copy and never touches the original.
tpl_empty_body: Register the customer's Excel test case file so test cases can be written into a copy of it.
tpl_remove_body: The stored copy of {name} is deleted. The original file and workbooks already written stay as they are.
tpl_legend: * required: item and trace. The trace column takes B*/R* IDs to match against the report.
tpl_file_help: .xlsx or .xlsm, up to 10 MB. The original stays where it is.
tpl_roles_help: Check each role against the header row; change a column if it was detected wrong.
tpl_replace: Replace a template with the same name
tpl_err_filename: This file name cannot be used; rename the file and choose it again.
tpl_err_workbook: This file is not an Excel workbook that can be read.
tpl_err_too_large: The file is too large; templates can be up to 10 MB.
tpl_err_name_taken: A template with this name exists. Pick another name or tick Replace.
tpl_err_file_clash: Another template already uses this name's file. Pick another name.
tpl_err_template: The template cannot be registered with this layout. Check the sheet and header row.
tpl_err_expired: The upload expired. Choose the file again.
tpl_err_mapping: Map these required roles to a column: {roles}.
tpl_err_row: Enter a header row number, e.g. 4.
cache_subtitle: The Production brief (master at the merge-base) is stored per repository and feature. A later survey reuses it when every file's blob hash still matches at the new merge-base; rows whose files changed are read again.
cache_readonly_body: To remove an entry, delete its folder; the next survey is then a cache miss and reads everything again.
cache_broken_body: This cache entry cannot be read ({reason}). The next survey of this feature reads everything again.
cache_empty_body: A survey stores its Production brief here after the tester reviews it.
settings_subtitle: Settings of this browser, console status and testign configuration.
settings_browser_note: Stored in the browser; applies to you on this machine only.
settings_lang_help: Changes the console's labels and buttons. Report content keeps the report's language.
settings_tester_help: Written to approved_by in the decisions log on Close QA. Required before a Close job is queued.
settings_reopen: Lost the tab or got a 403: reopen with
settings_config_note: Edit the file, then reload the page:
settings_m_output: Folder for each ticket's reports and workbooks
settings_m_refs: Production branch and current phase branch
settings_m_backlog: Backlog used for comments and the decisions log
settings_m_prefix: Prefix of the decisions log pages
agent_none: No agent attached: run /testign:console in Claude Code
agent_none_hint: Queued jobs wait until it attaches.
agent_none_body: Jobs you queue wait until a Claude Code session attaches to the console.
agent_none_queued: Your queued jobs are waiting; they start when a Claude Code session attaches.
agent_silent_hint: Open Jobs to mark the job failed or release the agent.
session_new_title: A new console tab was opened at {time}
session_new_body: If you did not open it, press Release agent and stop the console with `testign console stop`.
jobs_subtitle: Survey, Close and Testcase need an LLM, so they run through the open Claude Code session. The console never edits reports, workbooks or the wiki itself.
jobs_empty_open_body: Queue a survey from Tickets, or Close QA and test cases from a report.
jobs_no_progress_yet: The agent has not started this job yet.
jobs_waiting_turn: Waiting for its turn; jobs run one at a time.
jobs_ask_review_rows: Review each decision row before anything is written to the wiki.
jobs_ask_confirm_diff: Check the wiki diff before it is written.
jobs_ask_paste_pages: Paste the pages into the wiki yourself; testign wrote nothing.
jobs_requeue_latest: Queue again on the latest revision
jobs_silent_title: The agent has been silent for 15 minutes
jobs_silent_body: Mark the job failed, or release the agent so another Claude Code session can attach.
job_reason_server_stopped_body: The server stopped while the job was open or queued. Queue it again.
job_reason_session_lost_body: The Claude Code session that held this job was released or replaced.
job_reason_not_closed: Failed: the agent did not finish it
job_reason_not_closed_body: The agent asked for new work while this job was still open.
job_reason_marked_body: The job was marked failed after the agent went silent.
job_reason_revision_moved_body: A newer revision of the report was written after this job was queued, so it was not run on the old one.
job_reason_agent_body: The agent finished the job as failed; its report is below.
job_err_tester: Enter your tester name in Settings before Close QA.
job_err_template: Choose a template for this job.
job_err_no_template: Register a template first, in Templates.
job_err_unknown_template: That template is no longer registered.
job_err_unknown_workbook: That workbook is no longer in the ticket folder.
job_err_unknown_row: That row is not in the latest report.
job_err_no_revision: This ticket has no readable revision to work on.
job_err_conflict: This question was answered or replaced; the view is reloading.
job_tester_body: Your name is written to approved_by in the decisions log. It is saved in Settings for next time.
ask_only_this_job: This answer is used for this job only
ask_err_missing: Choose an option or write an answer for question {n}.
review_rows_title: Review decisions before writing to the wiki
review_rows_sub: Only the rows you approve are written. You see the diff once more before anything is written.
review_diff_sub: This is the tool's own preview; Write sends your confirmation of exactly this diff.
review_bad_edits: Change the decision, anchors or page of {rows}, or choose Write.
review_nothing_body: This job is not waiting for a row review, a diff or pages to paste.
review_no_pages: The preview has no page changes.
review_diff_note: Back tells the agent you did not confirm; nothing is written.
paste_heading: Paste the pages into the wiki
paste_sub: Manual mode: copy each page and paste it in Backlog yourself.
paste_title: testign wrote nothing to the wiki
paste_body: Replace each page's content with the text below, then press Done.
paste_note: Done tells the agent the pages are pasted.
survey_again_note: Filled in from the latest report. Check every value before queueing; fetch is never filled in.
survey_repo_help: Absolute path of a local git clone; the last one is remembered in this browser.
survey_feature_help: Optional; names the scout cache entry.
survey_err_ticket: Enter the ticket ID, e.g. DEMO-1.
survey_err_repo: Enter the absolute path of a local git clone, e.g. C:\work\app.
survey_err_ref: Use letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore or slash, e.g. develop.
survey_err_feature: Use letters, digits and dashes, up to 80.
trigger_latest_only: Jobs act on the latest revision; switch to it to queue one.
tpl_partial_upload: Merged cells and dropdown lists appear after the template is registered.
tpl_partial_large: This workbook is too large to read merged cells and dropdown lists here.
err_workbook_unreadable: This workbook cannot be read. Open it in Excel to check it, or pick another workbook.
job_err_session_too_new: This tab was opened after the job started. Answer from the console tab that was already open, or queue the job again.
job_reason_not_confirmed: Failed: the review table was not confirmed
job_reason_not_confirmed_body: You chose not to confirm the review table, so no row ran. Queue the import again to start over.
jobs_ask_review_table: The agent proposed the run plan. Check and confirm it in the review table; no row runs before you confirm.
jobs_from_chat_body: This job was queued by the agent from the chat.
job_err_unknown_project: Choose a project from the Login scenarios screen.
job_err_off_host: The URL is not on the project's allowed hosts.
job_err_bad_source: Enter a Figma design link with a node-id.
job_err_bad_base_url: Enter an absolute http or https URL.
job_err_plan_not_confirmed: Confirm the run's review table first.
job_err_unknown_run: That run no longer exists. Reload the page.
job_err_open_rows: The run still has open rows.
job_err_preconditions: A row you delegate to the agent needs its preconditions.
job_err_scenario_changed: The scenario changed since you opened it. Check it again.
job_err_not_an_image: The file must be a PNG or JPEG image.
job_err_unknown_scenario: A row names a login scenario that does not exist.
tpl_purpose_testcase_help: For test cases written from a report. Needs the item and trace columns.
tpl_purpose_webtest_help: For web test runs from a Figma change table. Needs the item column; result columns can be added at the review table.
runs_one_row: Runs from a queue · one row at a time
runs_subtitle: Each run imports a change table from Figma, waits for you to confirm one table, then the agent runs each row in your Chrome.
runs_unreadable: The run file cannot be read.
runs_empty_body: Queue one with the form: a Figma change table, a project and a template.
runform_figma_help: The design change table. Imported once; later runs make no Figma call.
runform_next_body: The agent imports and triages the rows, then asks you to confirm one table. No row runs before you confirm.
runform_no_project: A run needs a project with its allowed hosts. Create one on the Login scenarios screen.
runform_err_figma: Paste a Figma design link that has a node-id.
runform_err_base: Enter an absolute http or https URL.
runform_err_off_host: The URL's host is not one of the project's allowed hosts.
runform_err_name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
run_stale_title: The agent has been silent for over 2 minutes.
run_stale_body: It may be waiting for a browser permission in the terminal.
run_not_confirmed: The plan is not confirmed yet
run_not_confirmed_body: No row runs until the review table is confirmed.
run_review_waiting: The review table is waiting for you
run_review_waiting_body: Check the columns, screens and classes, then confirm once.
run_from_chat_body: The agent queued this run's job from the chat.
run_halted_body: Several rows in a row could not run. The agent asks you in the chat how to go on.
run_finished_body: Open rows end as not run; the agent writes the export.
run_finish_title: Finish the run with open rows?
run_finish_body: {n} rows are still open. They end as not run, and the agent exports the workbook and report.
run_finish_body_one: 1 row is still open. It ends as not run, and the agent exports the workbook and report.
run_no_rows: The run has no rows yet
run_answer_pending: answered, the agent applies it next
run_opt_delegate_note: The agent may press the buttons the steps name, on this row only.
run_opt_self_run_note: The row waits for your result in this panel.
run_opt_skip_note: The row ends as not run.
run_precond_ph: For example: booking #1042 of the client account, status Confirmed
run_precond_help: The agent uses only the data you name here.
run_queue_continues: The queue keeps running other rows while you answer.
run_answer_wait: The agent picks it up at its next row.
run_err_pick_action: Choose how to handle this row.
run_err_preconditions: Write the preconditions to delegate this row.
run_err_session: This tab opened after the run's job was queued. Use the tab you queued it from, or reload after the job ends.
run_err_image: The image must be a PNG or JPEG file.
run_err_image_size: The image must be under 20 MB.
rt_nothing_runs: No row runs before you confirm
rt_subtitle: The agent guessed the columns, screens, classes and login scenarios for {n} rows. Fix what is wrong, then confirm once.
rt_none_body: This job is not waiting on a review table now.
rt_hosts_note: From the project. Editable only on the Login scenarios screen.
rt_col_content: Change and reason for its class
rt_precond_required: Required when the agent runs this row
rt_warnings: {n} things to check (they do not stop the confirmation)
rt_warnings_one: 1 thing to check (it does not stop the confirmation)
rt_err_letter: The column for "{field}" needs a column letter.
rt_err_field_twice: Column {letter} repeats a field another column already fills.
rt_err_header: New column {letter} needs a header of 1 to 100 characters.
rt_err_new_left: New column {letter} must be to the right of the last header {last}.
rt_err_no_header: Column {letter} has no header in the template; remove it or add a new column.
rt_err_need_content: The column plan needs a Change column.
rt_err_need_verdict: The column plan needs a Result column.
rt_err_labels: Enter the labels for Pass and Fail.
rt_err_label_long: The label for {key} must be 50 characters or fewer.
rt_err_preconditions: {row}: a row you delegate needs its preconditions.
rt_err_scenario: {row}: the login scenario does not exist.
rt_err_screen: {row}: the screen must be a path like /news or a URL on the run hosts.
rt_warn_no_screen: {row}: no screen; the agent cannot run it and it ends as not run.
rt_warn_unapproved: {row}: the scenario {name} is not approved; approve it on the Login scenarios screen before the run.
rt_reject_body: The import job ends as failed and no row runs. Your edits here are not kept.
login_subtitle: A scenario is a checklist for signing in by hand in your own Chrome. The agent drafts it, you approve it. The agent types nothing into a sign-in form.
login_no_values: No screen takes or stores an account value
login_project_help: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 40 characters.
login_hosts_help: One host per line, without https://. The agent runs rows on these hosts only. Only you can edit them, here.
login_signin_help: For sites that go to an SSO page on another host.
login_err_host: Enter host names only, such as dev.example.com, without https:// or a path.
login_err_project_name: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 40 characters.
login_how_created: The agent drafts a new scenario when a row needs one; it asks you first.
login_steps_readonly: You do not edit the steps here. If one is wrong, reject with a note and the agent redrafts.
login_note_ph: For example: the staff sign-in page is /staff/login
login_err_note: Write a note so the agent knows what to fix.
login_remove_body: Rows that use this scenario do not run until the agent drafts it again and you approve it.
login_ask_body: Sign in by hand in your Chrome. The agent does not touch the browser while it waits for you.
login_ask_switch: The queue is switching from {from} to {to}. The agent does not touch the browser while it waits for you.
login_skip_note: If you skip, this scenario's rows do not run.
rt_err_mobile_agent: {row}: phone-width rows are run by you, not the agent.
job_err_mobile_agent: A phone-width row can only be run by you. Change its runner or viewport.
job_err_too_long: The text is too long. Shorten it and send again.
